ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can generate invoices and post entries automatically, but clerks still determine which item was posted incorrectly, how to reconcile a difference, and which rule applies.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 429,800 billing and posting clerks were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 427,900 by 2034, a net decrease of about 1,900 jobs, with approximately 42,200 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $47,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace billing clerks, but it will reduce entry-level roles. Automated billing and robotic process automation (RPA) accelerate routine invoicing and posting, shifting clerks from data entry toward exception review, rule interpretation, discrepancy resolution, and compliance control. People limited to data entry face displacement, while those who verify records and reconcile accounts become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Exception review: people find erroneous entries.
Rule interpretation: people select accounts.
Discrepancy resolution: people reconcile accounts.
Compliance control: people determine consistent treatment.
Customer coordination: people handle communication.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in the moderate-high exposure zone for accounting operations. Systems accelerate invoicing and posting, while verification and judgment still leave an essential role for people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not equal high risk. Data entry and posting tasks face replacement, not roles built around account verification. People who verify records and reconcile accounts become scarcer as efficiency rises, while clerks limited to entering numbers face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: When starting in finance or accounting, practice working with systems and paying close attention to detail. Pure data entry is shrinking in the AI era, so develop verification skills early.
Advance from data entry to verification plus reconciliation, learn RPA and financial systems, and seek responsibility for a module.
Emphasize invoicing and reconciliation experience and identify the systems you have used. Shared-service centers value consistency and accuracy.
When hiring, look beyond speed to verification judgment. Core staff who can reconcile accounts merit an allowance.

ai_s7_trends: RPA becomes widespread and data-entry roles shrink.
Shared-service centers consolidate work.
People who verify and reconcile accounts become more sought after.

body: Billing and posting clerks issue invoices, process receipts and payments, and post transactions. They coordinate bills, incoming funds, and account codes, use financial systems, reconcile differences, and follow up on corrections.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can generate invoices and post entries automatically, but clerks still determine which item was posted incorrectly, how to reconcile a difference, and which rule applies.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能自动开票和过账，但哪笔挂错、差异怎么平、规则怎么判，还是文员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年账单过账文员在岗约 42.98 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 42.79 万人，岗位净减约 0.19 万个，年均产生约 4.22 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.72 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代账单文员，但会压缩基础岗。自动计费与 RPA 把常规开票过账提速，文员从「录数过账」挪向「异常核对、规则判断、差异处理、合规把控」。真正被挤掉的是只做录入的，有核对力能平账的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 异常核对：错账靠人揪。
规则判断：科目靠人定。
差异处理：平账靠人。
合规把控：口径靠人。
客户协调：沟通靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的账务区——开票与过账被系统加速，但核对与判断还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「录入与过账」动作，不是「账务核对」的岗位。有核对力、能平账的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会录数的文员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 财务/会计起步多练系统和细心，AI 时代纯录数在缩，早点练核对。
从「录数」升级成「做核对 + 平账」，学 RPA 和财务系统，争取负责模块。
突出开票和对账经验，写清跟过哪些系统。共享中心看重稳和准。
选人别只看快，要看有没有核对脑子。能平账的骨干，值得给津贴。

ai_s7_trends: RPA 普及，录入岗缩。
共享中心集中。
有核对平账力的人更抢手。

body: 账单与过账文员主导发票开具、款项收付与账务过账，统筹账单、到账与科目，运用财务系统，核对差异并跟进更正。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 系统能自动开票和过账，但哪笔挂错、差异怎么平、规则怎么判，还是文员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Tools can assist signal processing and automatic mixing, but technicians remain responsible for on-site coordination and emergencies.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 92,300 audio and video technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 95,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,100 jobs, with approximately 7,300 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $54,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Audio And Video Technicians, but it will assist automatic mixing and signal detection. As systems balance themselves and issue alerts, technicians shift from moving faders toward coordinating operations and handling emergencies. Pure operating roles face displacement, while people who understand equipment and respond effectively on site become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: On-site coordination: people make the decisions.
Emergency response: people react in the moment.
Audio and video judgment: depends on experience.
Equipment coordination: depends on teamwork.
Quality control: people remain accountable.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10, moderate, means this occupation has meaningful AI exposure in on-site technical work. Systems absorb some equipment operation, while coordination and response remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Meaningful exposure does not mean universal risk. Pure equipment operation is being replaced, not on-site coordination. People who understand equipment and handle emergencies become scarcer as technology advances. Those limited to moving faders face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study media or electronics and gain hands-on equipment experience early.
Advance from assistant to on-site supervisor and build coordination experience.
Emphasize equipment and emergency-response experience, and identify the productions you have supported.
Assess candidates for steady hands and fast reactions. People who can handle livestream pressure are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Automatic mixing becomes widespread.
Livestream demand drives growth.
On-site coordination becomes scarcer.

body: Broadcast and live audiovisual technicians operate audio and video equipment for recording, livestreaming, and live sound reinforcement, ensuring sound and picture quality.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Tools can assist signal processing and automatic mixing, but technicians remain responsible for on-site coordination and emergencies.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 信号处理与自动混音能被辅助，但现场调度与突发，还是技术员扛。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年音频与视频技术员在岗约 9.23 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 9.54 万人，净增约 0.31 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.73 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.48 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代音视频技术员，但会辅助自动混音与信号检测。系统自平衡、自报警，技术员从「推子」转向「管调度、处突发」。真正被挤掉的是纯操作，会现场会应急的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 现场调度：决策靠人。
突发处置：反应靠人。
声画判断：经验靠人。
设备协同：默契靠人。
质量把关：责任靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光的现场区——操作被吃，但调度与处置仍留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于全风险：被替代的是「纯操作」，不是「现场调度」的岗位。会设备、能应急的人，反而随技术更稀缺。怕的是只会推推子的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读传媒电子，早点摸设备。
从助理升级成现场主管，攒调度。
突出设备与应急，写清跟过哪些现场。
选人看稳手与反应，能扛直播的值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 自动混音普及。
直播需求拉动。
现场调度更缺。

body: 广电与现场音视频技术员操作音频视频设备，完成录制、直播与现场扩声，保障声画质量。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 信号处理与自动混音能被辅助，但现场调度与突发，还是技术员扛。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: A monitor can sound an alarm, but an experienced nurse still decides how to respond when a patient's condition suddenly deteriorates.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reports that about 3,391,000 Critical Care Nurses were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 3,557,100 by 2034, a net gain of about 166,100 jobs, with roughly 189,100 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $93,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Critical Care Nurses, but it will reshape screen monitoring. Intelligent monitoring and alerts automate the aggregation of large data volumes, shifting nurses from watching numbers toward assessment, treatment adjustment, and care management. Basic documentation faces the most pressure, while nurses who exercise judgment and administer precise medication become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Automatic aggregation of monitoring data and alarms
ai_s3_list: Clinical assessment: people recognize deterioration.
Precise medication: people adjust infusion rates.
Resuscitation teamwork: people respond to emergencies.
End-of-life care: people protect dignity.
Accountability: people answer for errors.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score places this occupation at moderate AI exposure. Systems can take over monitoring and documentation, while assessment and precise care remain highly dependent on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not remove workplace pressure. Screen watching and recording are being replaced, not clinical judgment and care. Nurses who assess patients and administer medication precisely become scarcer as alert systems spread.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a strong nursing foundation and complete ICU placements while in school. Documentation is shrinking in the AI era, so practice assessment and resuscitation early.
Move beyond monitoring into assessment and precise medication administration. Earn a critical-care specialty qualification and work toward advanced practice.
Highlight ICU experience and credentials, and specify the conditions you have managed. Resuscitation experience is an advantage.
Do not hire on education alone. Evaluate steadiness and clinical judgment. Nurses who can perform during resuscitation merit higher allowances.

ai_s7_trends: Intelligent monitoring takes over data aggregation, shifting nurses toward assessment and care.
Demand for geriatric and critical care continues to rise.
Specialty nurses who understand equipment and alerts are in greater demand.

body: Critical Care Nurses care for patients with unstable vital signs in intensive-care units. They provide continuous monitoring, precise medication, life-support equipment management, and complication prevention while collaborating with physicians during high-risk periods.
career_ai_description_block.heading: A monitor can sound an alarm, but an experienced nurse still decides how to respond when a patient's condition suddenly deteriorates.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 监护仪能报警，但病人那一下恶化该怎么处置，还得护士凭经验定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年重症护理护士在岗约 339.10 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 355.71 万人，净增约 16.61 万个岗位，年均产生约 18.91 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.36 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代重症监护护士，但会重做盯屏。智能监护与预警把大量数据汇总自动化，护士从「看数字」转向「做评估、调治疗、管照护」。真正被挤掉的是基础记录，能判断、能精细给药的人更值钱。
ai_s2_auto: 监护数据的自动汇总报警
ai_s3_list: 评估判断：恶化要人识。
精细给药：泵速靠人调。
抢救配合：突发要人顶。
临终照护：尊严靠人守。
责任兜底：差错要人担。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——监测与记录能被系统接管，但评估判断与精细照护高度依赖人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于没压力：被替代的是「盯屏记录」，不是「判断与照护」。能评估、能给药的护士，反而随预警普及更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 护理底子打牢，在校多进 ICU 见习。AI 时代记录在缩，早点练评估与抢救。
从「会监护」升级成「会评估 + 精给药」，考危重症专科，争取转高级实践。
突出 ICU 经历与证书，写清跟过的病种。有抢救经验优先。
招人别只看学历，要看稳定和判断。能顶抢救的人值得给高补贴。

ai_s7_trends: 智能监护接管数据汇总，护士转向评估与照护。
老龄与重症需求持续上升。
懂设备与预警的专科护士更抢手。

body: 重症监护护士在危重病房护理生命体征不稳的患者，负责持续监测、精密给药、生命支持设备管理与并发症预防，在医生协作下守护高危患者的关键窗口期。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 监护仪能报警，但病人那一下恶化该怎么处置，还得护士凭经验定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Self-service systems can handle check-in, but Flight Attendants still stabilize the cabin, respond to emergencies, and reassure passengers.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 130,800 Flight Attendants employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 142,900 by 2034, a net gain of about 12,100 jobs, with about 19,800 annual openings. The 2026 median annual wage is about $67,100 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Flight Attendants, but it will reduce ground-service work. Check-in and some services become self-service, shifting attendants from meal delivery toward safety response, cabin service, and emergencies. Pure ground assistance is shrinking, while people with safety and service ability have greater stability.
ai_s3_list: Safety response: people stabilize emergencies.
Cabin service: people set the tone.
Care for illness: people provide compassion.
Conflict resolution: people manage emotions.
Arrival guidance: people maintain order.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates low-moderate AI exposure. Systems accelerate some tasks, but people retain work that requires judgment and accountability.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Systems replace ground-assistance tasks, not cabin safety and service roles. People with strong safety and service skills become scarcer as efficiency improves.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with service and language skills, then build safety capability and resilience. Pure assistance is shrinking in the AI era, so develop response skills early.
Advance from meal delivery toward safety + service and build emergency-response and language skills.
Emphasize calm emergency response and service. Airlines value resilience and professional presentation.
Do not hire on appearance alone. Assess safety awareness and resilience, and invest in strong long-term performers.

ai_s7_trends: Self-service expands and reduces ground work.
Cabin safety still depends on people.
Flight Attendants with response skills have greater stability.

body: Flight Attendants lead cabin safety and service. They coordinate demonstrations, meal service, and incident response, using procedures and communication to keep flights safe and serve passengers through arrival.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Self-service systems can handle check-in, but Flight Attendants still stabilize the cabin, respond to emergencies, and reassure passengers.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自助能办值机，但客舱怎么稳、突发怎么处、旅客怎么哄，还是空乘定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年空乘人员在岗约 13.08 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 14.29 万人，净增约 1.21 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.98 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.71 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代空乘人员，但会减少地面环节。值机与部分服务自助化，空乘从「送餐」挪向「安全处置、客舱服务、突发应对」。真正被挤掉的是纯地面辅助，懂安全、能服务的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 安全处置：突发靠人镇。
客舱服务：态度靠人。
不适照护：关怀靠人。
冲突化解：情绪靠人。
落地引导：秩序靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——部分环节被系统加速，但真正要人判断与兜底的地方还留着位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「地面辅助」动作，不是「客舱安全与服务」的岗位。有安全力、能服务的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 服务/外语起步多练安全和抗压，AI 时代纯辅助在缩，早点练处置。
从「送餐」升级成「安全 + 服务」，学处置与外语。
突出稳突发与服务，航司看重抗压和形象。
选人别只看形象，看安全意识和抗压，骨干值得给长线。

ai_s7_trends: 自助普及，地面缩。
客舱安全仍靠人。
能处置的空乘更稳。

body: 空乘人员主导客舱的安全与服务，统筹演示、供餐与处置，运用规范与沟通手段，保障航程安稳并服务旅客落地。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自助能办值机，但客舱怎么稳、突发怎么处、旅客怎么哄，还是空乘定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate materials, plan layouts, and produce construction drawings, but a craftsperson on the floor still has to feel a blistered surface or an uneven weld.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 33,700 Floor Layers, Except Carpet, Wood, And Hard Tiles employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 36,900 by 2034, a net gain of about 3,200 jobs, with about 2,700 annual openings. The 2026 median annual wage is about $54,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Floor Layers, Except Carpet, Wood, And Hard Tiles. Installation is hands-on site work. Workers judge the substrate by sight and touch, then cut, lay, and weld materials themselves. AI can calculate quantities, plan layouts, and schedule projects, freeing craftspeople from paperwork without replacing the craft.
ai_s2_accel: Floor scanners that check substrate flatness
ai_s2_auto: Automated material calculations and supply lists
Digital project scheduling and inspection records
ai_s3_list: Substrate assessment: spot blisters, moisture, and uneven areas by sight.
Cutting and seam alignment: finish irregular spaces by hand.
Welding craft: produce smooth, nearly invisible heat-welded seams.
Material knowledge: adapt methods to different flooring materials.
Site coordination: work with other trades.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates low-moderate AI exposure. Floor installation remains a hands-on site craft. AI can assist with material calculations, layouts, and management, but it cannot replace installation work in the near term.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still brings pressure. CNC cutting and prefabricated components compete for simple installation work. Specialize in sports, medical, or conductive flooring, and use automated equipment as a tool. Craft plus efficiency earns stronger rates.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Young people who want a trade can start directly as paid apprentices instead of focusing only on degrees. After several years, qualified workers can earn solid incomes. The work is physical, so protect your health and learn a specialty flooring craft early.

Move into specialty flooring and project management. Learn conductive and sports flooring for hospital and school projects. Digitize material calculations and scheduling so one person can deliver more work and quote with confidence.

People with no experience can start as apprentices or helpers. Focus on substrate preparation and welding. In interviews, emphasize stamina, steady hands, and willingness to learn. Workers who read drawings and calculate materials are more competitive.

Skilled flooring workers are difficult to recruit. Retain them with paid apprenticeships, raises after qualification, and specialty-process training. Give layout and material calculations to tools so craftspeople can focus on installation quality and productivity.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Even adhesive coverage across large areas
Detection of blisters and hollow spots

ai_s7_trends: Demand for commercial flooring in hospitals, schools, and sports venues continues to grow steadily.
New materials such as SPC stone-plastic composite flooring are becoming widespread and raising process requirements.
CNC prefabrication and layout tools are spreading, reducing manual material calculations.

body: Floor Layers, Except Carpet, Wood, And Hard Tiles install PVC, rubber, resilient, and other commercial or specialty flooring. They prepare substrates, mark layouts, cut, bond, weld, and finish edges to create level, attractive, durable floors.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate materials, plan layouts, and produce construction drawings, but a craftsperson on the floor still has to feel a blistered surface or an uneven weld.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动算料、排版、出施工图，但「这块地面起鼓了、那个缝焊不平」的现场手感，还得靠跪在地上的师傅。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年地板铺设工、地毯、木材、硬质瓷砖在岗约 3.37 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.69 万人，净增约 0.32 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.27 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.43 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代地板铺设工：铺设是典型的现场手艺活，基层情况要靠眼睛和手感判断，裁切铺贴焊接都得人上手。AI 能帮的是算料、排版、排期这些外围事务，把师傅从算账里解放出来，但手艺本身替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: 激光水平仪自动找平辅助
数控裁切设备预制板材
地面扫描仪检测基层平整度
ai_s2_auto: BIM 排版与施工图生成
工程排期与验收记录数字化
ai_s3_list: 基层判断：起鼓、返潮、不平一眼看出。
裁切对缝：异形空间的手工处理。
焊接手艺：热熔焊缝平整无痕。
材料经验：不同材质施工差异。
现场协调：跟其他工种的配合。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明地板铺设是「中高曝光」的现场手艺：核心动作都在真实空间里靠手完成，AI 只能在算料、排版、管理上帮忙，铺贴本身短时间替代不了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没压力：数控裁切和预制件在抢简单铺贴的活。往特种地面（运动地面、医疗地面、导电地面）专精，把自动化设备当工具用，手艺加效率才值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想学手艺的年轻人可以直接跟班当学徒，别只盯着学历。两三年出师后收入不错，但要想清楚是体力活，身体是吃饭的本钱，趁年轻学门特种地面手艺。
往特种地面和项目管理走：学导电地面、运动地面铺装，接医院学校项目；同时把算料和排期数字化，一个人能干两个人的活，报价底气都足。
零经验可以从学徒或帮手做起，重点是练基层处理和焊接；面试时强调能吃苦、手稳、愿意学。会看图纸、会算料的师傅更受欢迎。
手艺工人难招，建议「学徒带薪 + 出师涨薪 + 特种工艺培训」留人；把算料排版交给工具，让师傅专心干手艺，产能和口碑都上得去。

ai_s7_trends: 医院、学校、体育馆等商用地面需求稳定增长。
SPC 石塑板等新材料普及，施工工艺升级。
数控预制与排版工具普及，纯手工算料减少。

career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动算料、排版、出施工图，但「这块地面起鼓了、那个缝焊不平」的现场手感，还得靠跪在地上的师傅。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can watch satellite images, but a person still has to stop unsafe fires on site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 2,900 Forest Fire Inspectors And Prevention Specialists employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 3,300 by 2034, adding about 400 jobs and producing roughly 300 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $52,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Forest Fire Inspectors And Prevention Specialists, but satellite monitoring, fire-risk calculations, and report generation will become more automated. Inspectors create value through field enforcement, judgment, and communication. A risk score cannot decide whether to approve a burn permit or order an evacuation; a person must make that call.
ai_s2_accel: Automated drone patrols that supplement human inspections
Forest sensor networks that report temperature and humidity in real time
AI fire-spread simulations for prevention planning
AI-generated fire-prevention materials and training slides
ai_s2_auto: Satellite and remote-sensing monitoring with automated hotspot detection and alerts
Automated fire-risk ratings from weather and vegetation data
Online burn-permit applications and electronic approvals
ai_s3_list: Field enforcement and conflict resolution: people must persuade or cite visitors who violate fire rules.
Judgment in extreme weather: experience combines wind, humidity, and changing field conditions.
Communication with forest communities: residents, rangers, and visitors respond better to clear explanations than orders.
On-site hazard recognition: inspectors must see gaps in firebreaks and accumulations of dry fuel firsthand.
Emergency coordination: people organize patrols and joint response when fire risk rises.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 reflects a split occupation. AI can handle rule-based data work such as risk calculations, reports, and permit workflows. Field enforcement and judgment resist standardization, creating moderate exposure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not equal high risk. Smarter monitoring frees inspectors from watching data and gives them more time in the field. Prevention becomes more valuable, not less.

ai_s5_persona.advice: Forestry and fire-science programs offer useful preparation, but physical fitness and field adaptation also matter. Fieldwork is central to the occupation.
Learn drone operations and fire-risk monitoring systems. Let machines extend patrol coverage while you focus on enforcement and judgment, then advance toward fire-prevention supervision.
Ranger, firefighting, and military backgrounds transfer well. Describe burn-rule violations you handled and patrols you organized on your resume.
Deploy drones and monitoring platforms so employees can focus on enforcement and emergencies instead of repetitive patrols.

Mature fire-prevention platforms are shifting inspectors from mountain patrols toward enforcement, judgment, and coordination.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能盯着卫星图，但劝停违规用火还得人到场。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年消防检查员专员在岗约 0.29 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.33 万人，净增约 0.04 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.03 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.24 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: 直接回答：AI 不会取代森林消防检查员，但卫星监测、火险指数计算、报告生成这类工作会越来越自动化。检查员的核心价值在「现场执法 + 判断 + 沟通」——火险等级再高，最终要不要批用火许可、要不要疏散，还是要人拍板。
ai_s2_accel: 无人机巡护：无人机自动巡航补充人力巡查
传感器网络：林区传感器实时回传温湿度
预案推演：AI 模拟火情蔓延辅助预案制定
宣传教育：AI 生成防火宣传材料与课件
ai_s2_auto: 卫星与遥感监测：火情热点自动识别与告警
火险指数计算：气象与植被数据自动出火险等级
巡查报告生成：巡查数据自动汇总成报告
许可审批流程：用火许可在线申报与电子审批
ai_s3_list: 现场执法与冲突处理。面对违规生火的游客，怎么劝、怎么罚，AI 帮不上忙。
极端天气下的判断。风往哪刮、湿度降多快，这类综合判断靠经验。
与林区人群的沟通。跟村民、护林员、游客讲清楚为什么，比下命令有效。
设施与隐患的现场眼力。隔离带缺口、枯枝堆积，得亲眼排查。
应急时的组织协调。火险升级时怎么组织巡护、联动调度，要人统筹。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 评分 5/10 的逻辑：预防工作一半是数据活（火险计算、报告、许可流程）——规则清晰，AI 能接手；另一半是现场执法与判断——没法标准化。所以是中高曝光分。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险。监测越智能，检查员越能从「盯数据」里解放出来，把时间用在现场——预防的价值不是降低，是升高。

ai_s5_persona.advice: 林学、消防相关专业值得考虑，但要把体能和野外适应力练起来——这类岗位现场才是主战场。
主动学无人机和火险监测系统，让机器替你巡，你专注执法和判断，往防火主管走。
有护林、消防、退伍背景的人切入快。把「处理过用火违规、组织过巡护」写进简历。
配置无人机与监测平台，把人力从重复巡查解放到执法与应急上，别让人替机器干巡查的活。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can enter data, build spreadsheets, and draft emails, but clerks still know whom to contact and how to handle sensitive office communication.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 2,646,000 workers in 2024, projected to fall to 2,468,200 by 2034. That is a net loss of about 177,800 jobs, with roughly 282,400 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $43,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will replace some clerical jobs. Data entry, spreadsheet processing, filing, and email drafting are well suited to automation. Office Clerks, General are shifting from manual processing toward AI-assisted work, workflow coordination, and exception handling. Cross-department communication, on-site coordination, and unwritten organizational knowledge remain human strengths.
ai_s2_accel: Office AI assistants draft documents and emails
Intelligent archives and knowledge bases manage records
ai_s2_auto: Automated data entry and spreadsheet processing
ai_s3_list: Cross-department coordination: people know where to request data and why a process is stuck.
Exception handling: people decide what to do when a workflow does not cover the situation.
Face-to-face reception and service: visitors, calls, and urgent requests still need people.
Organizational judgment: experience reveals whom to contact and how to frame a request.
Responsibility and detail: people remain accountable for accurate records and reports.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 score places this occupation in a moderate-high AI exposure range. Data entry, filing, spreadsheets, and email work are rapidly automating.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not automatically mean high job loss for every clerk. As basic operations move to AI, employers expect stronger tool use and workflow coordination. Clerks who learn automation and process management can advance into administrative specialist and operations roles.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Basic clerical jobs are contracting. Study administration, human resources, or data operations, and build strong office software and data analysis skills before targeting specialist roles.
Learn office AI, RPA, and data analysis tools. Volunteer for workflow improvement and policy documentation. The durable path moves from miscellaneous tasks into process and operations ownership.
Clerical work can provide a transition into a new field. Build office software and communication skills, and describe workflows improved, records managed, and departments coordinated on your resume.
Do not hire clerks only for typing speed. Test tool learning and process awareness. Candidates who use AI productively and improve workflows can grow into specialist positions.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Drafts emails, edits documents, and records meeting notes
Moves approvals, reimbursements, and attendance online
Automates data transfers and repetitive workflows
Provides instant communication and collaborative documents

ai_s7_trends: Office AI and RPA are reducing pure data-entry and filing roles. Clerks are moving toward AI tool operation and workflow management.
Demand is shifting toward administrative and operations specialists who combine data analysis with process improvement.
As knowledge bases and intelligent archives mature, human value shifts from file handling to coordination and judgment.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能录数据、做表格、写邮件，但「这件事该找谁、怎么把话说圆」，还得文员来办。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年普通办公室文员在岗约 264.60 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 246.82 万人，岗位净减约 17.78 万个，年均产生约 28.24 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.36 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 会取代一部分文员岗位，数据录入、表格处理、文件归档和邮件草拟正是 AI 最擅长的。文员从「手工录入整理」转向「用 AI 工具提效 + 协调流程 + 处理例外」。真正不可替代的是跨部门沟通、现场协调、处理没写进流程的突发情况，以及那些「只有人知道怎么回事」的组织默契——AI 能执行任务，但接不住办公室里的人情和变数。
ai_s2_accel: 办公 AI 助手撰写文档与邮件
RPA 机器人自动跑流程
智能档案与知识库管理
流程自动化替代线下签字
ai_s2_auto: 数据录入与表格处理自动化
文件归档与检索智能化
邮件与日程管理自动化
ai_s3_list: 跨部门沟通协调：数据找谁要、流程卡在哪，靠人脉和沟通。
处理例外情况：流程没覆盖的事，临场判断怎么办。
面对面的接待与服务：来访、电话、领导临时交办，机器接不住。
组织默契与判断：知道什么事找谁办、什么话怎么说，靠经验。
责任心与细节：文件、台账、报表的准确性，最终由人负责。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业的案头工作正被快速自动化——录入、归档、表格、邮件都有 AI 代劳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。恰恰因为基础操作被 AI 接管，文员被要求「更会用工具、更会协调流程」，向行政专员和流程管理转型的人反而有空间。真正被挤压的是纯录入整理岗位，会办公自动化、懂流程的文员会升级而不是失业。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 纯文员岗位在收缩，建议读行政管理、人力资源或数据运营相关专业，把办公软件和数据分析能力打牢，向专员方向规划。
把办公 AI、RPA 和数据分析工具用熟，主动承接流程优化和制度整理。从「做杂事」升级为「管流程、做运营」，是文员唯一的长期出路。
文员适合作为转行过渡岗，重点练办公软件和沟通能力。简历上多写「优化过什么流程、管理过什么台账、对接过哪些部门」。
招文员别只看打字快，要看工具学习能力和流程意识。会用 AI 工具提效、能主动优化流程的人，值得给到专员岗位。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 邮件草拟、文档润色、会议纪要
数据搬运、重复流程自动化

ai_s7_trends: 办公 AI 与 RPA 普及，纯录入整理岗位大幅收缩，文员向「AI 工具操作 + 流程管理」转型。
行政与运营专员岗位需求增长，会数据分析、懂流程优化的复合型行政人才吃香。
知识库与智能档案成熟后，文件管理进一步自动化，人的价值转向协调与判断。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: ATS can screen thousands of resumes in seconds, but it is still up to the HR manager to decide which candidate can really take on the job, how to improve the team culture, and how to discuss signs of resignation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that there will be approximately 221,900 human resources managers on the job in 2024, and this number is expected to rise to 233,000 by 2034, with a net increase of approximately 11,100 positions, an average annual vacancy of approximately 17,900, and a median annual salary of approximately US$140,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI won’t replace HR managers, but it will speed things up. ATS, payroll robots and employee self-service speed up screening, calculation, and Q&A, and HR managers move from "following the process" to "organizational diagnosis, talent strategy, labor negotiation, and cultural implementation." What is really being squeezed out is HR who only do transactional processes. People who understand business and can diagnose are more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Early warning of turnover risk model
ai_s2_auto: ATS automatically screens resumes and schedules initial interviews
Salary accounting and personal tax are automatically issued
Automatic transfer of attendance and leave requests
ai_s3_list: Tissue diagnosis: The root cause of the disease depends on people.
Labor negotiations: Emotions rely on people to level up.
Cultural implementation: The atmosphere depends on people.
Key appointments: Vision depends on people.
Compliance: standards are judged by people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 shows that this profession is in a medium-to-high-exposure business area - screening and calculation are accelerated by the system, but diagnosis and negotiation still leave room for people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium and high exposure does not mean high risk: what is replaced are "transactional process" actions, not "organizational operations" positions. People with business acumen and talent strategy skills are increasingly scarce as efficiency improves. What I’m afraid of is people who only send out offers and get approval.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Basic knowledge in human resources/psychology/business, and practice data and communication in school. In the AI ​​era, pure business is shrinking, so understand the business early.
Upgrade from "following the process" to "doing OD + understanding business", learn HR data analysis, and strive to become a business partner.
Highlight the organization and performance cases, and write down which large-scale teams you have worked with. Enterprises value stability and know-how.
When selecting people, don’t just look at the process; you should also understand the business. HR who can do talent strategy deserves a high salary.

ai_s7_trends: HR SaaS consumes business, and OD demand rises.
Human data analysis has become a new threshold.
HRBPs who understand business are more in demand.

body: The human resources manager coordinates corporate recruitment, training, compensation and performance, employee relations and compliance, connects the business with human resources planning, uses HR systems and data to support organizational effectiveness, and is the central manager of talent operations.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: ATS 能秒筛几千份简历，但哪个候选人真能扛事、团队文化怎么补、离职苗头怎么谈，还是 HR 经理定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年人力资源经理职业诊断在岗约 22.19 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 23.30 万人，净增约 1.11 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.79 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 14.00 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代 HR 经理，但会加速事务。ATS、薪酬机器人和员工自助把筛选、核算、问答提速，HR 经理从「走流程」挪向「组织诊断、人才战略、劳资谈判、文化落地」。真正被挤掉的是只做事务性流程的 HR，懂业务能诊断的人更值钱。
ai_s2_auto: ATS 自动筛简历与初面排期
薪酬核算与个税自动出
ai_s3_list: 组织诊断：病根靠人找。
劳资谈判：情绪靠人平。
文化落地：氛围靠人带。
关键任命：眼光靠人定。
合规拿捏：尺度靠人判。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的事务区——筛选核算被系统加速，但诊断与谈判还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「事务性流程」动作，不是「组织运营」的岗位。有业务脑子、能做人才战略的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会发offer走审批的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 人力/心理/商科打底，在校多练数据与沟通。AI 时代纯事务在缩，早点懂业务。
从「走流程」升级成「做 OD + 懂业务」，学 HR 数据分析，争取当业务伙伴。
突出组织与业绩案例，写清跟过哪些规模团队。企业看重稳和懂行。
选人别只看流程熟，要看懂不懂业务。能做人才战略的 HR，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: HR SaaS 吃事务，OD 需求升。
人力数据分析成新门槛。
懂业务的 HRBP 更抢手。

body: 人力资源经理统筹企业招聘、培训、薪酬绩效、员工关系与合规，对接业务做人力规划，运用 HR 系统与数据支撑组织效能，是人才运营的中枢管理者。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can schedule appointments, maintain records, and program keys for smart locks, but when a lock refuses to open, the work still depends on skilled hands.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 18,800 locksmiths and safe repairers were employed in 2024, declining to a projected 17,200 by 2034. That represents roughly 1,600 fewer jobs, with about 1,700 openings per year and median annual pay of approximately $50,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace locksmiths, but it will change the structure of the business. AI is taking over appointment dispatch, customer records, inventory management, and some remote smart-lock configuration, shifting locksmithing from a purely mechanical craft toward a combination of mechanical, electronic, and service skills. What remains irreplaceable is identifying locks on site, opening them by hand, adjusting safes, and earning trust during on-site service. Customers entrust their doors and valuables to the person, not merely the tools.
ai_s2_accel: Remote smart-lock configuration and firmware debugging
Wider adaptation and installation of fingerprint and facial-recognition locks
Integrated installation of security monitoring and access-control systems
ai_s2_auto: Scheduling lockout appointments and dispatching mobile service
Digitizing customer files and service records
Automated key duplication with key-cutting machines and CNC equipment
ai_s3_list: On-site lock identification: recognizing a lock's brand, model, and opening method at a glance takes accumulated experience.
Manual and nondestructive lock opening: opening a door while minimizing damage to the lock is both a craft and the basis of a strong reputation.
Safe combination-mechanism adjustment: repairing combined mechanical and electronic structures allows little room for error and requires a person.
Identity verification and compliance judgment: refusing suspicious customers and keeping required records depend on professional integrity.
On-site service and communication: explaining solutions, quoting prices, and arranging times are themselves competitive strengths.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score means process and service tasks are being automated: systems now handle appointments, dispatching, records, and CNC key duplication.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. As smart locks spread, locksmiths need stronger electronic knowledge and debugging skills, making professionals who combine mechanical craftsmanship with electronic expertise more valuable. The real pressure falls on traditional locksmiths who only replace simple lock cylinders and refuse to learn new technology.

ai_s5_persona.建议: A university degree is not essential, but foundational study in mechanics, electronics, or security is useful. Apprentice under a reputable locksmith, master mechanical locks and safes first, and then learn smart locks.

Learn smart-lock installation and configuration as well as electronic-lock repair, and actively serve institutional customers such as offices, stores, and property managers. Advancing from a lockout technician to a security-service provider can substantially increase business volume.

Career changers with mechanical, electronic, or security backgrounds can learn quickly. Obtain required certification and registration before accepting jobs, and describe the lock types you know, the number of on-site calls you have completed, and the organizations you have served on your résumé.

Do not hire locksmiths based only on seniority; assess their willingness to learn smart locks and new equipment. Professionals who bring tools on site, configure smart locks, follow service standards, and maintain required records are more sought after than those limited to traditional techniques.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Rapid duplication of transponder and cut-pattern keys
Nondestructive opening of pin-tumbler and wafer locks
Fingerprint enrollment, remote configuration, and firmware updates
Appointment dispatch, service records, and compliance documentation
Testing and acceptance of access-control and surveillance systems
On-site quotations, invoicing, and payment collection

ai_s7_trends: As smart and electronic locks become mainstream, locksmiths are shifting from opening and replacing locks toward smart-lock installation, configuration, and security engineering, creating a clear premium for combined skills.
Traditional mechanical-lock business is shrinking, while demand for safe, bank, and institutional security maintenance remains stable. Institutional customers form a dependable revenue base.
On-site service is becoming standardized and registration oversight is tightening. In the platform era, compliant locksmiths with strong reputations become more valuable.

body: Locksmiths and safe repairers provide individuals, stores, and organizations with lock-opening, key-duplication, lock installation and replacement, and safe-repair services. They verify customer identities and follow required procedures in a specialized technical service occupation combining mechanical craftsmanship with mobile service.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你预约、记档、配智能锁钥匙，但面对一把打不开的锁，下手靠的还是那双有手艺的手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年锁匠保险柜在岗约 1.88 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.72 万人，岗位净减约 0.16 万个，年均产生约 0.17 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.05 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代锁匠，但会改变生意结构。预约派单、客户档案、库存管理、部分智能锁的远程配置都被 AI 接手，锁匠从「纯机械手艺」转向「机械 + 电子 + 服务」的复合技能。真正不可替代的是现场判断锁型、手工艺开锁、保险柜调试，以及上门服务的信任——客户把门和贵重物品交给你，认的是你的人。
ai_s2_accel: 智能锁远程配置与固件调试
电子锁故障诊断辅助系统
指纹/人脸锁适配与安装普及
安防监控与门禁系统一体化安装
ai_s2_auto: 开锁预约与上门派单调度
客户档案与服务记录电子化
配钥匙机与数控钥匙复制自动化
锁具库存与报价单管理
ai_s3_list: 现场锁型判断：一眼看出锁的品牌、型号和开启方式，靠经验积累。
手工开锁与无损开启：在尽量不破坏门锁的前提下打开，是手艺也是口碑。
保险柜密码机构调试：机械+电子结构的维修，容错率低，必须人来。
身份核验与合规判断：可疑客户拒接、按规备案，靠的是职业底线。
上门服务与沟通：跟客户解释方案、报价、约时间，服务本身就是竞争力。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的流程与服务类工作正被自动化——预约、派单、记录、数控配钥匙都有系统代劳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。恰恰因为智能锁普及，锁匠被要求「更懂电子、更会调试」，机械手艺加电子技能的人更值钱。真正被挤压的是只会简单换锁芯、不学新技术的传统锁匠。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 不一定要高学历，但建议学机械、电子或安防相关专业打底。找靠谱师傅拜师，先把机械锁和保险柜的硬功夫练出来，再学智能锁。
把智能锁安装调试和电子锁维修学起来，主动接机构客户（写字楼、商铺、物业）。从「开锁匠」升级为「安防服务商」，业务量会上一个台阶。
有机械、电子或安防背景的转行者上手快。先考证备案再接单，简历上多写「掌握哪些锁型、做过多少上门服务、服务过哪些机构」。
招锁匠别只看资历，要看是否愿意学智能锁和新设备。能带工具上门、会调试智能锁、服务规范守备案的师傅，比只会老手艺的更抢手。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 芯片/齿形钥匙快速复制
弹子锁、叶片锁无损开启
指纹录入、远程配置、固件更新
预约派单、服务记录、备案留档
门禁、监控系统测试与验收

ai_s7_trends: 智能锁与电子锁成为主流，锁匠从「开锁换锁」转向「智能锁安装调试 + 安防工程」，复合技能溢价明显。
传统机械锁业务收缩，但保险柜、银行与机构安防维修需求稳定，机构客户成为收入基本盘。
上门服务标准化、备案监管趋严，守规矩、有口碑的锁匠在平台时代反而更值钱。

body: 锁匠与保险柜维修师为个人、商铺与机构提供开锁、配钥匙、锁具安装更换与保险柜维修服务，需要验证客户身份、按规范操作，是融合机械手艺与上门服务的特种技术服务岗位。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate a display rendering with one click, but you still need to adjust the mannequin's angle and lighting height on site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 193,000 merchandise displayers and window trimmers were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 199,300 by 2034. That represents roughly 6,300 additional jobs and about 20,800 openings per year, with median annual pay of approximately $37,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace merchandise displayers, but it will change how they work. AI is taking over initial display concepts, renderings, and data analysis, shifting display professionals from concept designers toward on-site implementation and data optimization. Machines cannot replace aesthetic judgment, spatial placement, prop construction, or physical execution. Displayers who implement concepts and interpret data become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: AI visual recognition to analyze store compliance
Customer-traffic heat maps supporting placement decisions
ai_s2_auto: One-click AI generation of display renderings
ai_s3_list: Aesthetic judgment: selecting attractive colors and forms requires talent and accumulated experience.
Spatial placement: find on-site angles that floor plans cannot reveal.
Prop-building craftsmanship: cutting, securing, and lighting adjustment require hands-on ability.
On-site execution: people align every centimeter between the drawing and the physical space.
Combining data with aesthetics: use reports to adjust displays so they both look good and sell well.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score means AI is accelerating about half of the concept-design tasks. It can assist with renderings, data analysis, and materials lists.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. AI takes over concept generation, while on-site implementation remains. Physical setup, prop construction, and aesthetic judgment become more important. Pure rendering roles face pressure, while displayers who implement concepts and understand data become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study visual communication, exhibition design, or marketing and build a portfolio through internships. Practice both design software and hands-on setup. Your portfolio matters more than your transcript.

Use AI rendering and data tools and actively study commercial display standards and retail operations. Advance from display execution toward an integrated role covering concepts, implementation, and data, and pursue relevant visual-merchandising credentials.

A design or retail background helps, but beginners can start as display assistants or materials coordinators. Include complete projects in your portfolio and specify setup cycles, budgets, and performance data.

Do not hire displayers based only on portfolio aesthetics; assess implementation ability. Candidates who build props, work overnight setups, and clearly explain the data logic behind decisions offer the rarest combination.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Generate display renderings with one click
Use photo recognition to verify display compliance

ai_s7_trends: As AI rendering and data analysis spread, displayers shift from drawing concepts toward implementation and data optimization, combining aesthetics with execution.
As retail becomes omnichannel, physical displays and online visuals share a common source, increasing demand for displayers who understand content visuals.
As experiential retail grows, displayers evolve into combined roles covering spatial-experience design and marketing campaigns.

body: Merchandise displayers and window trimmers manage visual merchandising at retail locations, including themed window and store design, shelf and mannequin placement, prop and lighting setup, materials purchasing and execution, and sales-data-based placement optimization.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能一键生成陈列效果图，但模特摆到哪个角度、灯光打在哪个高度，还得你蹲在现场调。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年商品陈列员橱窗布置员在岗约 19.30 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 19.93 万人，净增约 0.63 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.08 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.73 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代商品陈列员，但会改变工作方式。陈列方案初稿、效果图、数据分析正被 AI 接管，陈列师从「方案设计师」转向「现场落地+数据优化」——审美判断、空间摆位、道具搭建和落地执行，是机器替代不了的。能落地又会看数据的陈列师反而更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: AI 视觉识别分析门店陈列执行度
客流热力图辅助摆位决策
AR 眼镜辅助现场布置
ai_s2_auto: 陈列效果图 AI 一键生成
物料清单与下单电子化
ai_s3_list: 审美判断：什么配色、什么造型吸引人，眼光是天赋加积累。
空间摆位：平面图上看不出的立体感，现场找角度。
道具搭建的手艺：剪裁、固定、灯光调校，动手能力。
落地执行：图纸到现场的距离，靠人一厘米一厘米对齐。
数据与美学的结合：看报表调整陈列，让好看也好卖。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半的方案设计任务正被 AI 加速——效果图、数据分析、物料清单，AI 都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 接管的是「出方案」环节，留下的是「落地」环节——现场布置、道具搭建、审美判断反而更重要。真正被压缩的是纯画图岗，能落地、懂数据的陈列师更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选视觉传达、展示设计或市场营销专业，多实习积累作品集。把设计软件和现场动手都练起来，作品集比成绩单重要。
把 AI 出图和数据工具用起来，主动学商业陈列规范与零售运营。从「执行陈列」升级为「方案+落地+数据」三合一，考相关陈列师认证。
有设计或零售背景最好，无背景可从陈列助理和物料执行做起。作品集多放「完整项目」，写清楚布展周期、预算和效果数据。
招陈列师别只看作品集的美，要看落地能力。能自己搭道具、能熬夜布展、又能讲清楚数据逻辑的候选人，是最稀缺的组合。

ai_s7_trends: AI 出图与数据分析普及，陈列师从「画图」转向「落地+数据优化」，审美与执行并重。
零售全渠道化，线下陈列与线上视觉同源，懂内容视觉的陈列师更抢手。
体验式零售兴起，陈列师向「空间体验设计+营销活动」复合角色转变。

body: 商品陈列员与橱窗布置员负责零售终端的视觉陈列，包括橱窗与门店场景的主题设计、货架与模特陈列、道具灯光布置、物料采购与执行，并结合销售数据优化陈列位置。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate exams and courseware, but nursing instructors must still watch students' hand positions in the skills lab and correct a misplaced needle or incomplete disinfection step.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show that about 91,600 postsecondary nursing instructors and teachers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 106,900 by 2034, a net increase of about 15,300 jobs, with roughly 8,600 openings per year and a median annual wage of about $79,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace nursing instructors, but it will optimize instructional support. AI greatly accelerates courseware generation, test assembly, literature searches, and virtual simulations, freeing instructors for what matters most: skills supervision, transfer of clinical experience, and individual guidance. Nursing education builds skills into muscle memory, and someone must supervise that practice.
ai_s2_accel: Error prompts from intelligent training equipment
ai_s2_auto: Automatic generation of courseware and handouts
ai_s3_list: Skills supervision: repeatedly correct students' hand positions.
Clinical experience: turn real cases into teaching examples.
Individualized instruction: use different methods for different students.
Career guidance: help students through difficult internships.
Quality control: uphold every nursing-procedure standard.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means AI deeply supports the knowledge side of nursing education, including courseware, test banks, and literature. Its core, however, is skills supervision, which depends on an instructor's observation, correction, and demonstration and has low automation potential.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Using AI as a teaching assistant is an advantage. Let students first practice safely in virtual simulations and use AI to save preparation time, then invest that time in the skills lab. Supervision quality is the foundation of a nursing instructor's value.

ai_s5_persona.建议: To become a nursing instructor, first become a nurse. Clinical experience is a firm requirement. After a bachelor's degree, spend several years in clinical practice before pursuing a master's degree. Universities require doctorates, while vocational colleges often accept master's degrees. Families should support the long path from clinic to classroom.

Pursue a dual-qualified path combining clinical practice and teaching. Continue clinical development, bring current nursing techniques into class, use AI to streamline preparation and assessment, and invest time in skills supervision and curriculum development.

Clinical nurses commonly transition into teaching. Begin as an adjunct instructor or clinical preceptor, then earn a higher-education teaching credential and move full-time. Prepare a 15-minute demonstration lesson on your strongest nursing specialty for interviews.

Nursing-instructor shortages are large. Broaden recruitment of dual-qualified candidates with master's degrees + clinical experience, retain them through hospital partnerships and vacation-period clinical development, and assign teaching mentors to young instructors. Mentorship often retains people better than salary increases alone.

ai_s7_trends: Expansion of nursing education sustains growth in demand for instructors.
Virtual simulation and intelligent patient simulators become standard in skills training.
Dual-qualified instructors combining clinical practice + teaching become the recruitment norm.

body: Postsecondary nursing instructors and teachers teach nursing in higher and vocational education. They deliver theory, supervise skills, guide clinical placements, develop curricula, and advise students on academic and career development.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can generate exams and courseware, but nursing instructors must still watch students' hand positions in the skills lab and correct a misplaced needle or incomplete disinfection step.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动出试卷、能做教学课件，但「学生这针扎偏了、这步消毒没到位」——实训室里盯着手型纠错，还得靠护理教师。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年教师、高等教育在岗约 9.16 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 10.69 万人，净增约 1.53 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.86 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.99 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代护理教师，但会优化教学的「支持面」：课件生成、题库组卷、文献检索、虚拟仿真操作都被 AI 大幅加速，教师能把时间省下来做真正重要的事——实训带教、临床经验传承和对学生的个别指导。护理教学的本质是「把技能练成肌肉记忆」，这一环必须有人盯着练。
ai_s2_accel: 虚拟仿真护理操作训练
AI 临床病例情景教学
智能实训设备纠错提示
ai_s2_auto: 成绩统计与教学档案管理
ai_s3_list: 实训带教：盯着手型一遍遍纠正。
临床经验：把真实病例讲成教学案例。
因人施教：对不同学生用不同教法。
职业引导：帮学生度过实习低谷。
质量把关：守住护理操作的每一道规范。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明护理教学的「知识面」已被 AI 深度支持——课件、题库、文献都是 AI 主场；但教学的核心环节「带教」是技能传承，依赖教师的观察、纠错和示范，这部分自动化程度低，所以评分居中。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 把 AI 当教学助手是加分项：用虚拟仿真让学生先练不犯错，用 AI 备课省时间，把省下的时间放在实训室里——带教质量才是护理教师的立身之本。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想当护理教师，先当护士：临床经验是硬门槛，本科毕业后先临床几年再考研读硕；高校教职要博士，职业院校硕士即可，家里要支持孩子「先临床后讲台」的长路径。
走双师型路线：保持临床进修，把最新护理技术带进课堂；用 AI 工具提效备课和考核，把时间投到实训带教和课程开发上。
临床护士转教学是常见路径：先做外聘讲师或临床带教积累经验，再考高校教师资格证转全职；面试时准备一节 15 分钟的试讲，讲你最熟的专科护理。
护理教师缺口大，建议放宽「硕士+临床」的双师型招聘，用临床医院合作和寒暑假进修留人；给年轻教师配备教学导师，比单纯涨薪更能留住人。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 高风险操作无风险练习

ai_s7_trends: 护理教育扩招，护理教师需求持续增长。
虚拟仿真与智能模拟人成为实训标配。
双师型（临床+教学）教师成为招聘主流。

body: 护理教师在高等教育与职业教育机构教授护理学课程，负责理论授课、实训带教、临床实习指导、课程开发与学生学业职业辅导。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动出试卷、能做教学课件，但「学生这针扎偏了、这步消毒没到位」——实训室里盯着手型纠错，还得靠护理教师。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Navigation can assist alignment, but the surgeon still decides which leg needs replacement and how to respond to bleeding during surgery.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), in 2024 about 14,700 surgeons were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 15,300, a net increase of about 600 jobs, with about 400 openings per year. In 2024, median annual pay was ≥$239,200 (top BLS OES category, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace orthopedic surgeons, but it will support their decisions. Image recognition and surgical navigation accelerate diagnosis and alignment, shifting surgeons from purely manual work toward image interpretation + planning + intraoperative response. Surgeons limited to standard procedures face displacement, while those with strong judgment become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Diagnostic decisions: people set the direction.
Intraoperative response: people control bleeding.
Complex procedures: people handle difficult operations.
Physician-patient communication: people build trust.
Team leadership and quality control: people bear responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 indicates moderate AI exposure. Imaging and navigation are accelerated, but human surgeons retain responsibility for operating and deciding.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. What is being replaced is the routine work of reading standard images and performing standard procedures, not roles requiring complex decisions. Surgeons who exercise judgment and can operate become even scarcer as efficiency improves. The vulnerable position is one limited to assembly-line procedures.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Medical training is long, so develop image-reading skills and steady hands early. In the AI era, routine image reading is shrinking; practice decision-making.
Advance from performing procedures to developing plans + leading teams, and learn navigation and rehabilitation coordination.
Highlight your subspecialty and surgical volume, and specify the procedures you have performed. Hospitals value steadiness and responsibility.
Do not select candidates by education alone; assess intraoperative response. Core surgeons who can independently perform complex procedures deserve a strong platform.

ai_s7_trends: Navigation robots enter operating rooms
Growth in minimally invasive and same-day surgery
Population aging drives demand for joint replacement

body: Orthopedic surgeons diagnose and surgically treat disorders of bones, joints, ligaments, and the spine. They coordinate imaging assessment, surgical plans, and postoperative rehabilitation to restore patients' mobility.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Navigation can assist alignment, but the surgeon still decides which leg needs replacement and how to respond to bleeding during surgery.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 导航能帮对位，但哪条腿该换、台上出血怎么应变，还是医师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年外科医师在岗约 1.47 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.53 万人，净增约 0.06 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.04 万个职位空缺，2024 年中位数年薪 ≥$239,200（BLS OES 最高档，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代骨科医师，但会辅助决策。影像识别与手术导航把诊断与对位提速，医师从「纯手工」挪向「读片 + 方案 + 台上应变」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准术式的人，有决策力的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 诊断决策：方向靠人定。
台上应变：出血靠人控。
复杂术式：难靠人做。
医患沟通：信任靠人建。
带组质控：责靠人担。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光区——影像与导航被加速，但主刀与决策还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「看标准片、做标准术」动作，不是「复杂决策」的岗位。有判断、能上台的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做流水线术式。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 医学路长，早点练读片与手稳，AI 时代纯看片在缩，练决策。
从「做术式」升级成「定方案 + 带组」，学导航与康复协同。
突出亚专业与手术量，写清做过哪些术式。医院看重稳与责。
选人别只看学历，要看台上应变。能独立复杂术式的骨干值得给平台。

ai_s7_trends: 导航机器人进手术室
微创与日间手术增
老龄拉动置换需求

body: 骨科医师诊断并手术治疗骨骼、关节、韧带与脊柱相关疾病，统筹影像评估、手术方案与术后康复，恢复患者运动功能。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 导航能帮对位，但哪条腿该换、台上出血怎么应变，还是医师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Robots can dispense and verify medications, but a pharmacist still has to stop two drugs from being taken together when the combination is dangerous.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 335,100 pharmacists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 350,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 15,400 jobs, with about 14,200 openings annually and a 2026 median annual salary of about $137,500 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace pharmacists, but it will take over part of dispensing. As systems handle automated dispensing, prescription-review rules, and interaction alerts, pharmacists shift from retrieving medications toward medication judgment, chronic disease management, and patient education. People who identify risks and manage drug therapy are truly scarce.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent reminders for chronic disease management
ai_s3_list: Risk identification: people assess complex interactions.
Clinical judgment: people determine plan adjustments.
Patient communication: people resolve concerns and misconceptions.
Medication therapy management: people follow individualized plans.
Final accountability: people are responsible for dispensing errors.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 places this occupation in a moderately to highly exposed area of dispensing. Systems and robots replace standardized actions, but medication judgment and education still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-to-high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is retrieving and checking medications, not the occupation itself. Pharmacists who review prescriptions and provide clinical pharmacy and chronic disease management become scarcer as automation diverts routine work. Those who only fill prescriptions and do not learn new systems face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in pharmacy and earn pharmacist licensure while in school. Pure dispensing is shrinking in the AI era, so develop clinical pharmacy and communication early instead of focusing only on retrieving medications.
Advance from retrieving medications to medication management, study clinical pharmacy and chronic disease, and seek clinical pharmacist roles rather than remaining in mechanical dispensing.
Emphasize prescription-review and medication-education experience, and specify interactions you have handled. Hospital and chronic disease experience are preferred.
Hire for professional judgment and communication, not just dispensing speed. Pharmacists capable of clinical pharmacy work deserve higher performance pay.

ai_s7_trends: Automated dispensing and prescription review continue expanding, shrinking dispensing roles.
Demand rises for clinical pharmacy and chronic disease management.
Versatile pharmacists who exercise judgment and manage therapy are more sought after.

body: Pharmacists review physician prescriptions, prepare and verify medications, identify drug interactions and contraindications, provide medication guidance and safety consultation to patients and healthcare professionals, and manage medication quality and inventory to ensure safe, effective, and economical use.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Robots can dispense and verify medications, but a pharmacist still has to stop two drugs from being taken together when the combination is dangerous.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 调剂和核对能交给机器人，但「这两种药一起吃会不会出事」，还得药剂师拦。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年药剂师职业诊断在岗约 33.51 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 35.05 万人，净增约 1.54 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.42 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 13.75 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代药剂师，但会接管部分调剂。自动发药、审方规则和相互作用提示交给系统后，药剂师从「拿药」挪向「用药判断、慢病管理与患者教育」。真正稀缺的是能甄别风险、做药物治疗管理的人。
ai_s2_auto: 处方调剂与发药的自动化
库存与近效期自动管理
ai_s3_list: 风险甄别：复杂相互作用靠人判。
临床判断：方案调整靠人定。
患者沟通：担忧和误区靠人解。
药物治疗管理：个体方案靠人跟。
责任兜底：发药差错要人担。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的调剂区——标准化动作能被系统和机器人替代，但用药判断与教育还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「拿药核对」，不是「岗位」。会审方、能做临床药学和慢病管理的人，反而随自动分流变得更稀缺。怕的是只会照方拿药、不学新系统的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 药学打底，在校把执业药师考了。AI 时代纯调剂在缩，早点练临床药学和沟通，别只盯着拿药。
从「拿药」升级成「用药管理」，学临床药学和慢病，争取转临床药师，别停留在机械调剂。
突出审方和用药教育经验，写清处理过哪些相互作用。有医院和慢病经验优先。
招人看专业判断和沟通，不止看拿药速度。能做临床药学的药剂师值得给更高绩效。

ai_s7_trends: 自动发药与审方持续铺开，调剂岗收缩。
临床药学与慢病管理需求上升。
会判断会管理的复合药剂师更抢手。

body: 药剂师审核医师处方，调配与核查药品，甄别药物相互作用与禁忌，向患者和医护提供用药指导与安全咨询，管理药品质量与库存，保障用药的安全、有效与经济。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 调剂和核对能交给机器人，但「这两种药一起吃会不会出事」，还得药剂师拦。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can compare prices automatically, but purchasing agents still decide which suppliers are reliable, how to negotiate long-term arrangements, and how to resolve shortages.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 522,200 purchasing, wholesale, retail, and farm-products workers were employed in 2024, projected to rise to 552,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 30,100 jobs, with about 52,200 openings annually and median annual pay of about $75,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace purchasing agents, but it will reduce standardized roles. Purchasing systems and automated sourcing accelerate routine price comparisons, shifting agents from issuing standard POs toward managing suppliers, negotiating strategic prices, controlling risk, and safeguarding supply. Roles limited to data entry and price comparison face the greatest pressure, while people with strong commercial management skills become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Supplier management: people build relationships.
Strategic negotiation: people negotiate prices.
Risk response: people resolve material shortages.
Category judgment: people make tradeoffs.
Cross-functional coordination: people drive progress.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 indicates that this occupation has moderately high exposure in purchasing: systems accelerate standard procurement, but supplier management and negotiation still leave a clear role for people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk: issuing standard POs is replaced, not supplier-management roles. People with strong commercial management skills become scarcer as efficiency rises. Those limited to data entry and price comparison face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with supply-chain or international-trade training and build category and data skills. Pure price-comparison work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop supplier-management skills early.
Advance from issuing POs to category management + supplier development, learn data skills, and pursue strategic pricing.
Highlight category experience and cost savings, and specify the materials you have managed.
Do not hire based only on eloquence. Look for supplier-management ability. People who safeguard supply and reduce costs deserve high bonuses.

ai_s7_trends: Purchasing systems spread, reducing standardized roles.
Supplier management creates opportunities.
People with strong commercial management skills are in greater demand.

body: Purchasing agents, except wholesale, retail, and farm products, coordinate material sourcing, price negotiation, and delivery management, operate purchasing systems, manage suppliers, safeguard supply, and control costs.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can compare prices automatically, but purchasing agents still decide which suppliers are reliable, how to negotiate long-term arrangements, and how to resolve shortages.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能自动比价，但哪家供应商靠谱、怎么谈长期、缺料怎么救，还是采购定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年采购、批发、零售、农场产品在岗约 52.22 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 55.23 万人，净增约 3.01 万个岗位，年均产生约 5.22 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.57 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代采购代理，但会压缩标准岗。采购系统与自动寻源把常规比价提速，代理从「下标准 PO」挪向「经营供应商、谈战略价、管风险、保供应」。真正被挤掉的是只做录入比价的人，有经营力的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 供应商经营：关系靠人养。
战略谈判：价位靠人谈。
风险处置：缺料靠人救。
品类判断：取舍靠人。
跨部门协调：推动靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的采购区——标准采购被系统加速，但经营与谈判还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「下标准 PO」动作，不是「供应经营」的岗位。有经营力的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做录入比价的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 供应链/国贸起步多练品类和数据，AI 时代纯比价在缩，早点练经营。
从「下 PO」升级成「管品类 + 经营供应商」，学数据，争取战略价。
突出品类和降本，写清管过哪些物料。
选人别只看口才，要看会不会经营。能保供降本的人值得给高奖金。

ai_s7_trends: 采购系统普及，标准岗缩。
供应商经营带来机会。
有经营力的人更抢手。

body: 采购代理（非批零农）统筹物料寻源、议价与交期管理，操作采购系统经营供应商，保障供应并控制成本。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 系统能自动比价，但哪家供应商靠谱、怎么谈长期、缺料怎么救，还是采购定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Online listings and automated valuations can replace standard showings, but brokers still decide which clients to nurture, how to bring parties to a deal, and how to navigate complex transactions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 420,900 real estate brokers and sales agents were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 433,700 by 2034, a net increase of about 12,800 jobs, with approximately 36,600 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $56,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace brokers, but it will reduce standard showings. Online listings and automated valuations accelerate routine matching, shifting brokers from showings toward client development, deal negotiation, complex transactions, and long-term trust. Listing-only roles face displacement, while people who build relationships and close deals become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Customer relationships: people cultivate trust.
Deal negotiation: people build consensus through conversation.
Complex transactions: people navigate the process.
Local knowledge: people understand neighborhoods.
Long-term relationships: people build repeat business.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this occupation in a transaction area with moderate AI exposure. Systems accelerate standard showings, while deal-making and trust remain human-led.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk: listing and showing tasks are replaced, not the deal-making role. People who build relationships and navigate complex transactions become scarcer as efficiency rises. Listing-only brokers face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin in sales or customer service and develop local knowledge and communication. Pure showings are shrinking in the AI era, so learn client development early.
Advance from showings to deal-making + client development. Learn mortgage and tax processes and aim to become a top producer.
Highlight closings and client resources, specifying the neighborhoods you have covered. Agencies value consistency and drive.
Do not assess candidates only by speaking ability; look for business-development judgment. Key staff who nurture leads deserve high commissions.

ai_s7_trends: As online listings spread, standard showings shrink.
Complex transactions and local trust create opportunities.
Brokers with client-development skills are in greater demand.

body: Real estate brokers and sales agents lead the matching of properties and clients and facilitate transactions. They coordinate showings, price negotiations, mortgages, and transfers and use local knowledge and service to complete real estate deals.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Online listings and automated valuations can replace standard showings, but brokers still decide which clients to nurture, how to bring parties to a deal, and how to navigate complex transactions.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 线上房源和自动估价能替标准带看，但哪类客户值得养、怎么撮合成交、复杂流程怎么走，还是经纪定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年房地产经纪人与销售代理在岗约 42.09 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 43.37 万人，净增约 1.28 万个岗位，年均产生约 3.66 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.63 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代经纪，但会压缩标准带看。线上房源与自动估价把常规匹配提速，经纪从「带看」挪向「客户经营、撮合谈判、复杂交易、长期信任」。真正被挤掉的是只挂房源的，有经营力能撮合的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 客户经营：信任靠人养。
撮合谈判：共识靠人聊。
复杂交易：流程靠人走。
本地知识：地段靠人懂。
长期关系：复购靠人建。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光的交易区——标准带看被系统加速，但撮合与信任还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「挂房源带看」动作，不是「做撮合」的岗位。有经营力、能走复杂交易的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只挂房源的经纪。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 销售/客服起步多练本地知识和话术，AI 时代纯带看在缩，早点练经营。
从「带看」升级成「做撮合 + 养客户」，学贷税流程，争取王牌。
突出成交和客户资源，写清跑过哪些片区。门店看重稳和冲。
选人别只看口才，要看有没有经营脑子。能养客源的骨干，值得给高佣金。

ai_s7_trends: 线上房源普及，标准带看缩。
复杂交易与本地信任带来机会。
有经营力的经纪更抢手。

body: 房地产经纪人与销售代理主导房源与客源匹配及交易撮合，统筹带看、议价、贷款与过户，运用本地知识与服务手段，达成房产交易。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 线上房源和自动估价能替标准带看，但哪类客户值得养、怎么撮合成交、复杂流程怎么走，还是经纪定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Self-service reception can register visitors, but receptionists still handle personal hospitality and complex coordination.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 1,007,200 receptionists and information clerks were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 1,007,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 400 jobs, with approximately 128,500 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $37,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace receptionists, but it will reduce routine registration. Kiosks and systems accelerate visitor check-in, shifting receptionists from issuing badges toward coordination, administration, and personal hospitality. Registration-only roles face displacement, while people who coordinate and transition into broader work become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Personal hospitality: people make guests feel respected.
Complex coordination: people organize emergencies.
Administrative coordination: people manage matters.
Emotional reassurance: people ease frustration.
Multichannel dispatch: people create order from confusion.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this occupation in an administrative area with moderately high exposure. Systems accelerate registration, while coordination remains human-led.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk: issuing badges and registering visitors are replaced, not reception and coordination roles. People who coordinate and transition become scarcer as efficiency rises. Badge-only receptionists face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin in secretarial work and develop system and coordination skills. Pure registration is shrinking in the AI era, so learn administration early.
Advance from issuing badges to coordination + administration, and learn office systems.
Highlight professional presentation and communication and specify the systems you have used. Companies value steadiness and smooth coordination.
Do not hire solely based on appearance; assess coordination judgment. Key staff who can transition deserve retention.

ai_s7_trends: Self-service reception spreads
Routine roles are shrinking
Coordination skills are in greater demand

body: Receptionists and information clerks receive visitors, transfer calls, and enter information. They coordinate registration, routing, and arrangements and use communication and systems to keep reception operations running.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自助前台能登记，但人情接待和复杂协调，还是接待员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年前台接待员与信息文员在岗约 100.72 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 100.76 万人，净增约 0.04 万个岗位，年均产生约 12.85 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.72 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代前台，但会压缩常规登记。自助机与系统把访客登记提速，接待员从「发证」挪向「协调、行政、人情接待」。真正被挤掉的是只登记的，有协调力能转型的更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 人情接待：面子靠人给。
复杂协调：突发靠人理。
行政统筹：事靠人管。
情绪安抚：烦靠人顺。
多线调度：乱靠人安。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的行政区——登记被系统加速，但协调还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「登记发证」动作，不是「协调接待」的岗位。有协调力、能转型的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会发证的接待。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 文秘起步多练系统和协调，AI 时代纯登记在缩，早点练行政。
从「发证」升级成「做协调 + 行政」，学办公系统。
突出形象和沟通，写清跟过哪些系统。公司看重稳和顺。
选人别只看长相，要看有没有协调脑子。能转型的骨干值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 自助前台普及
常规岗缩
协调力更抢手

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Shampooing and scalp massage require supporting a client's head and feeling the scalp to judge pressure. Robots still cannot learn the sensitivity required for this close-contact service.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 18,500 shampooers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 19,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,100 jobs, with approximately 2,700 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $31,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace shampooers because this is a fully hands-on, close-contact service role that depends on touch. Systems take over appointments and membership reminders, but shampooing and massage cannot be automated in the near term. The real concern is the occupation's low entry barrier and easy replacement by new workers, not machines taking the work.
ai_s2_auto: Systematic appointment scheduling and customer reminders
Digital membership profiles and preference records
Automated restocking reminders for shampoo supplies
ai_s3_list: Appropriate hand pressure: people judge close-contact service.
Scalp observation: experience identifies abnormalities.
Emotional reassurance: people help clients relax.
Preventing water intrusion: human hands protect the ears.
Coordination with hairstylists: people communicate on site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this occupation in a moderately high AI-exposure category for hands-on services. Systems only take over appointment records, while people continue to shampoo and massage.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Appointment recordkeeping is being replaced, not the hands that wash hair. The true pressure comes from low entry barriers and high turnover, not machines. Developing renowned technique and service creates greater stability.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Hair and beauty training schools provide quick entry, but do not stop at shampooing. Learn haircutting while working and advance toward hairstyling, or new workers can easily replace you.
Make shampooing a signature service, develop scalp-observation and care-recommendation skills, and learn haircutting to become an assistant hairstylist. Do not remain limited to rinsing hair.
Highlight technique and service reviews, clearly stating how many regular clients you have served. Salons value steady hands and strong client rapport.
Do not hire solely on low cost; assess touch and approachability. Shampooers who retain clients deserve higher commissions.

ai_s7_trends: As scalp care grows, demand for professional shampooers remains stable.
Chain salons standardize operations, making technique training more systematic.
Transitioning from shampooer to assistant hairstylist becomes the primary career path.

body: Shampooers provide shampooing, scalp massage, basic care, and seating guidance in hair salons. They adjust water temperature and hand pressure to ensure comfort and safety and serve as the key experience role connecting reception with hairstyling.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 洗头按摩要托着头、摸着头皮找力度，机器人现在还学不会这份贴脸的分寸。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年洗发师在岗约 1.85 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.96 万人，净增约 0.11 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.27 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.15 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代洗发师，这是纯人手、贴脸、靠手感的服务岗。预约和会员提醒被系统接管，但洗头按摩本身短期无法自动化。真正要担心的是岗位门槛低、易被新人顶替，而不是被机器抢。
ai_s2_accel: 头皮检测仪的辅助诊断
培训视频与手法标准化
ai_s2_auto: 预约排班与客户提醒的系统化
会员档案与偏好记录的数字化
洗发用品库存的自动补货提醒
评价与回访的自动化推送
ai_s3_list: 手法力度分寸：贴脸服务要人拿捏。
头皮状态观察：异常要靠经验看。
情绪安抚：客人放松靠人陪。
防进水细节：手护耳朵靠人手。
与发型师衔接：现场沟通靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的纯服务区——系统只接管预约记录，洗头按摩留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「记预约」动作，不是「洗头的手」。这行真正的压力来自门槛低和流动性大，而非机器。把手法和服务练成口碑，反而越来越稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 美发培训学校入门快，但别停在做洗发。边做边学剪发，往发型师走，否则容易被新人顶。
把洗发做成招牌服务，练头皮观察和护理推荐，学剪发转助理发型师，别只停留在冲水。
突出手法和服务评价，写清带过多少熟客。沙龙看重手稳和客人缘。
招人别只看便宜，要看手感和亲和力。能留住客人的洗发师，值得给高提成。

ai_s7_trends: 头皮护理升温，专业洗发师需求稳。
连锁沙龙标准化，手法培训更系统。
洗发师向助理发型师转型成主流路径。

body: 洗发师在美发沙龙为顾客进行洗头、头皮按摩、基础护理与入座引导，调节水温和手法力度，保障洗发过程的舒适与安全，是美发服务流程中承接待与发型设计的关键体验岗。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can consolidate business intelligence into a briefing, but the person in charge still decides the organization's next move and bears responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 309,400 chief executives were employed in 2024, projected to rise to 322,700 by 2034, a net gain of about 13,300 jobs, with about 22,200 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $206,400 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace chief executives. As AI handles business analysis, intelligence summaries, and scenario simulations, executives devote more time to strategic judgment, organizational leadership, and crisis accountability. People who commit amid uncertainty and accept responsibility for outcomes are truly scarce. Machines cannot assume this ultimate accountability.
ai_s2_auto: Automated consolidation of business reports and intelligence
Automated monitoring of industries and competitors
Analytical assistance and reminders for routine decisions
ai_s3_list: Strategic judgment: Determine direction.
Organizational leadership: Mobilize the executive team.
Crisis accountability: Bear responsibility when problems occur.
Resource allocation: Make bets and tradeoffs.
External representation: Communicate with boards and markets.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in the moderately high exposure range for business information. AI accelerates consolidation, monitoring, and drafting, but people retain full control over decisions and accountability.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. AI replaces reviewing and writing, not deciding and bearing responsibility. The stronger AI becomes, the more organizations need people to set direction and own outcomes. The primary risk is not replacement, but poor decisions.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Do not treat CEO as an entry role. First achieve results in a function, then develop strategy and leadership. In the AI era, accountability and judgment determine success.

Advance from managing one area to seeing the entire organization. Learn strategy, finance, and organizational leadership. Pursue general manager or top leadership roles rather than remaining solely in execution.
Executive roles are won through results and reputation, not ordinary applications. Show what you have led and which crises you have resolved.
Evaluate strategic resolve and crisis accountability, not only career history. Leaders who own results merit equity.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Financial and operational data on one screen

ai_s7_trends: AI business intelligence is spreading, allowing executives to focus more on decisions.
Organizational risk and compliance monitoring are becoming intelligent.
Versatile leaders who drive digital transformation are becoming scarcer.

body: As organizations' highest-ranking managers, chief executives set strategic direction and objectives, coordinate functions, allocate critical resources, and bear ultimate responsibility to boards, shareholders, and markets for decisions and outcomes.
