ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把经营情报汇成一份简报，但「这一步棋往哪落」，还得一把手拍板扛责。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年首席执行官在岗约 30.94 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 32.27 万人，净增约 1.33 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.22 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 20.64 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代首席执行官。经营分析、情报摘要和情景模拟交给 AI 后，高管把时间更多投向战略判断、组织领导与危机担当。真正稀缺的是能在不确定里下注、并为结果负责的人——这是机器不敢接的终极责任。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助战略情景模拟
ai_s2_auto: 经营报表与情报的自动汇总
行业与 competitor 的自动监测
例行决策的辅助分析与提醒
董事会材料的自动起草
ai_s3_list: 战略判断：往哪走。
组织领导：带得动班子。
危机担当：出事扛得住。
资源配置：押注与取舍。
外部代表：对董事会市场。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的经营信息区——汇总、监测、草稿都能被加速，但决策和担当仍牢牢在人手里。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「看和写」，不是「决和担」。AI 越强，越需要人来定方向和扛结果。怕的不是被替，是决策失误。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 别把 CEO 当起点。先在一个职能做出成绩，再补战略与领导力。AI 时代拼的是担当与判断。
从「管一摊」升级成「看全局」，学战略财务与组织。往总经理/一号位走，别只守执行。
高管岗不靠投简历，靠业绩和口碑。亮出你带过什么、救过什么。
选人看战略定力和危机担当，不止看履历。能扛结果的一号位值得给股权。

ai_s7_trends: AI 经营情报普及，高管更聚焦决策。
组织风险与合规监控智能化。
能带数字化转型的复合型一号位更稀缺。

body: 首席执行官作为组织最高管理者，制定战略方向与目标，统筹各职能条线、配置关键资源，代表组织对董事会、股东与市场承担最终决策与结果责任。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能把经营情报汇成一份简报，但「这一步棋往哪落」，还得一把手拍板扛责。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can automatically call offside and Hawk-Eye can determine whether a ball is out with precision, but a referee's eyes and composure still decide whether a tackle was malicious.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 19,300 umpires, referees, and other sports officials were employed in 2024, with employment projected to rise to 20,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,100 jobs. The occupation generates approximately 4,600 openings annually, and median annual pay was about $38,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace referees, but it will change the structure of officiating. Offside detection, Hawk-Eye, and replay systems are taking over objective calls, freeing officials from watching lines and allowing them to focus on subjective foul judgments and match control. AI is an enhancement, not a substitute. People still manage player emotions and the rhythm of the contest.
ai_s3_list: On-site judgment of subjective fouls: AI cannot determine intent and officiating thresholds.
Match tempo and control: presence and authority defuse tension.
Communication with players and coaches: explain calls and resolve conflict through skillful language.
Composure under controversy: apply decisions consistently amid boos from the entire venue.
Understanding rule boundaries: people must study new rules, precedents, and officiating standards.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 means technology is taking over objective officiating. Offside, boundary, and replay decisions are automated, but subjective calls and match control remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure still brings change. Technology replaces line-watching roles, while the referee's core value shifts toward subjective judgment and on-site management. The more AI assistance spreads, the more important distinctly human officiating abilities become.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Young people who love sports and respect rules can explore this path. Earn a qualification first and accumulate assignments in school and amateur competitions. Develop fitness, rules knowledge, and resilience because progress depends gradually on experience and reputation.
Master semi-automated offside and replay systems and advance toward higher-level competitions. Also explore referee instruction and event management to broaden income sources.

Sports enthusiasts commonly transition into officiating. Earn a level-based credential first, then build match experience. On a resume, clearly state the sports, number of assignments, and certification levels rather than speaking vaguely about passion.
Event organizers should assess practical experience and resilience, not only certificates. Strong AI assistance reduces controversy and improves referee efficiency.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Real-time communication between referees and assistant referees
Quick reference for new rules and a precedent library

ai_s7_trends: As semi-automated offside and replay systems spread, technology takes objective calls while referees focus on subjective judgments and match control.
Expansion of the sports industry increases competitions and demand for officials, but career progression still centers on assignments and certification levels.
Data-driven officiating and AI reviews are becoming standard in training, shifting referee development from experience alone to a combination of data and experience.

body: Umpires, referees, and other sports officials enforce rules during competitions, determine scores and fouls, maintain order, resolve disputes involving athletes and coaches, and issue official rulings on results.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动判越位、鹰眼能精准出界，但「这个铲球到底是不是恶意」的现场裁决，还得看裁判的眼睛和定力。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年裁判、仲裁员与其他体育官员在岗约 1.93 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.04 万人，净增约 0.11 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.46 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.88 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代裁判，但会改变判罚结构。越位检测、鹰眼、回放系统正接管客观判罚，裁判从「盯线」中解放出来，把精力放在主观犯规判断和现场控场上。AI 是裁判的「外挂」，不是裁判的「替代」——球员的情绪、比赛的节奏，还得人来管。
ai_s2_accel: AI 犯规风险评估辅助
ai_s3_list: 主观犯规的现场判断：动作意图和尺度，AI 给不了。
比赛节奏与控场：怎么让火药味降下来，靠气场。
与球员教练的沟通：解释判罚、化解冲突，靠话术。
争议压力下的定力：全场嘘声里保持判断一致。
规则边界的理解：新规、判例、尺度，靠人钻研。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的客观判罚环节正被技术接管——越位、出界、回放都自动化了，但主观判罚和控场还是人的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化。被技术替代的是「盯线」角色，裁判的核心价值转向主观判断和现场管理。AI 辅助越普及，对裁判的「人」的能力要求反而越高。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 热爱体育又有规则精神的孩子适合试水：先考证，从校园和业余赛事积累场次。把体能、规则和抗压都练起来，这条路靠场次和口碑慢慢走。
把半自动越位、回放系统用熟，往高级别赛事走。同时学裁判讲师、赛事管理方向，拓宽收入来源。
体育爱好者转裁判是常见路径，先考等级证书再攒场次。简历上写清楚执裁项目、场次和等级，比空谈热爱有用。
赛事方招裁判别只看证书，要看实战场次和抗压记录。给裁判配好 AI 辅助系统，能减少争议、提高效率。

ai_s7_trends: 半自动越位与回放系统普及，客观判罚交给技术，裁判聚焦主观判断与控场。
体育产业扩张带动赛事增多，裁判需求上升，但职业化路径仍以场次和等级为核心。
判罚数据化与 AI 复盘成为培训标配，裁判培养从「经验带」转向「数据+经验」结合。

body: 裁判、仲裁员与其他体育官员在体育比赛中执行规则、判定得分与犯规、维持比赛秩序、处理运动员与教练争议，并对比赛结果出具官方裁定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can absorb much of the repetitive, structurable work of Veterinary Assistants And Laboratory Animal Caretakers, but judgment, accountability, and interpersonal coordination still rest with people. What actually gets squeezed out is pure execution.

Employment is projected to rise to 128,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 10,300 jobs, with approximately 22,200 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $37,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace veterinary assistants and laboratory animal caretakers, but it will reshape their workflows by assigning repetitive, structured tasks to tools and allowing people to focus on judgment, responsibility, and creative problem-solving. Scripted execution will lose value, while professionals who adapt to real situations and make decisions will become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Use data profiles to accelerate assessment of clients and animal care needs.
Use simulations and scenario exercises to accelerate evaluation of veterinary assisting and laboratory animal care plans.
Use retrieval tools to verify veterinary assisting and laboratory animal care information and regulations.
Use collaboration tools to accelerate cross-team coordination in veterinary assisting and laboratory animal care.
ai_s2_auto: Automatically generate structured documents and reports for veterinary assisting and laboratory animal care.
Process and categorize repetitive data in veterinary assisting and laboratory animal care.
Perform rules-based initial screening and scheduling for veterinary assisting and laboratory animal care.
Search veterinary assisting and laboratory animal care knowledge bases and extract key points.
ai_s3_list: Professional judgment and tradeoffs in real veterinary assisting and laboratory animal care situations.
The ability to explain veterinary assisting and laboratory animal care knowledge to non-specialists.
Accountability and final review in veterinary assisting and laboratory animal care.
Cross-functional resource integration and interpersonal coordination in veterinary assisting and laboratory animal care.
Reuse of tacit knowledge gained through long-term veterinary assisting and laboratory animal care experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: Scoring rationale: AI can assist veterinary assistants and laboratory animal caretakers, but professional judgment and final accountability are difficult to replace, resulting in 5/10 exposure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Turn 5/10 into an advantage: let AI take the repetitive work, and spend your time on real projects, judgment, and people.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a strong foundation in veterinary assisting and laboratory animal care and gain experience on real projects.
Connect your existing experience to veterinary assisting and laboratory animal care and identify a differentiated entry point.
Turn veterinary assisting and laboratory animal care experience into products or management capabilities to increase leverage.
Use AI to reduce repetitive work in veterinary assisting and laboratory animal care and focus on decisions.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Draft veterinary assisting and laboratory animal care content and plans
Core veterinary assisting and laboratory animal care work

ai_s7_trends: First, collaboration between veterinary assisting and laboratory animal care professionals and AI will become routine, making tool proficiency an entry requirement.

body: Veterinary assistants and laboratory animal caretakers restrain, feed, and monitor animals under veterinary supervision. They collect samples, assist with procedures, maintain enclosures and care records, and protect animal welfare and orderly clinical operations.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can absorb much of the repetitive, structurable work of Veterinary Assistants And Laboratory Animal Caretakers, but judgment, accountability, and interpersonal coordination still rest with people. What actually gets squeezed out is pure execution.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能吞掉兽医助理与实验动物照护员的大量重复与可结构化任务，但判断、责任与人际协调仍由人扛；真正被挤掉的是纯执行层。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年兽医助理与实验动物照护员在岗约 11.78 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 12.81 万人，净增约 1.03 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.22 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.73 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代兽医助理与实验动物照护员，但会重塑Veterinary Assistants And Laboratory Animal Caretakers的作业流：把重复与可结构化任务交给工具，人聚焦判断、责任与创造。真正被挤掉的是照本宣科式执行，会结合真实场景、会决策的人更值钱。
